preconditions.description: The length of string s must be between 1 and 100,000.
The length of string t must be between 1 and 100,000.
The product of the lengths of s and t must not exceed 10,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum number of occurrences of string t in string s after replacing question marks.

raw_response: {"interface":{"mode":"stdin_stdout","signature":"stdin -> stdout"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"1 <= len(s) <= 10**5","description":"The length of string s must be between 1 and 100,000."},{"id":"P2","expression":"1 <= len(t) <= 10**5","description":"The length of string t must be between 1 and 100,000."},{"id":"P3","expression":"len(s) * len(t) <= 10**7","description":"The product of the lengths of s and t must not exceed 10,000,000."}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"stdout == str(max_occurrences)","description":"The output must be the maximum number of occurrences of string t in string s after replacing question marks."}],"invariants":[]}
